capabilities: Search anime and organize a tracking shelf
Manage fansub RSS subscriptions and downloads through qBittorrent
Fetch and merge danmaku with audio offset calibration
Launch local or remote players for episodes
Sync Bangumi collection status, progress, ratings, and short reviews
disambiguation: Not a video or media hosting service; it coordinates external downloaders, players, and Bangumi, and provides no copyright license for video resources.
extras: Desktop features are Windows-only in part (boot scheduling, idle exit); macOS, Linux and physical mobile devices are not yet end-to-end verified. Credentials in data.json are unencrypted. Optional Bangumi mirror routes the access token through a third-party service. Auto-clean deletes media files.
problem: Tracking seasonal anime, fansub downloads, danmaku playback, and Bangumi progress normally requires several separate apps outside Obsidian.

relations.evidence: 交给 qBittorrent 管理 RSS 与下载
推荐安装 弹弹play；PotPlayer、mpv、VLC 也可以作为播放器
维护 Bangumi 收藏状态、评分和短评，后台队列推送修改
官方弹幕采用 AniClip 的删减时间数据

requires.name: Python with NumPy and FFmpeg for audio offset calibration
Bilibili login session for danmaku sources
WebDAV/SFTP/FTP/SMB service and rclone for remote media
Kodi, Jellyfin or Emby for network playback

summary: Anime tracking plugin that searches series, manages fansub RSS downloads via qBittorrent, plays episodes with danmaku, and syncs Bangumi progress and ratings.
